title: Cybersecurity in the Healthcare Sector
description: Discover our customized cybersecurity offering for the healthcare sector. Protect patient data and information systems against any attack.

sections.title: Cybersecurity in the Healthcare Sector
sections.lead: Victrix offers a customized cybersecurity service for the healthcare sector. Protect patient data, your connected medical devices, and your information systems against all cyber threats.

sections.title: First-Class Cybersecurity and Confidentiality for Healthcare Organizations

featured.title: Extensive experience in the healthcare sector
featured.text: Our cybersecurity consultants understand the challenges healthcare providers face on a daily basis. We use cybersecurity best practices to protect your personal information and strengthen the security of your healthcare facility's systems.

aside.title: Personalized support
aside.text: To ensure optimal security for your healthcare organization, it is essential to achieve and maintain the highest standards — this is where professional support becomes indispensable.

items.title: Governance and Resilience
items.text: Prepare healthcare facilities to deal with cyber threats and be able to conduct a cyber risk self-assessment.

items.title: Resources and Sharing
items.text: Identify and increase the number of professionals, ensure sufficient budget to strengthen cybersecurity and digital technology, and find a cybersecurity service tailored to specific and priority needs.

items.title: Raising Awareness of Cybersecurity in Healthcare
items.text: Raise awareness among senior management, raise awareness and train all employees, and implement cybersecurity crisis drills in case of phishing attacks or other threats.

items.title: Operational Security
items.text: Secure facility directories (AD) and medical equipment (IoT), manage exposure risks and access, and develop a business continuity and disaster recovery plan.

sections.title: From Strategy to Cyber Resilience
paragraphs: Strategy and governance — protect patient safety and personal data with our strategic approach: we identify your assets, analyze your risk, and ensure compliance to elevate the security of your sensitive medical data.

IT modernization — counter cyber threats and stay ahead of technological advances: virtualization, automation, and strategic orchestration, enhanced perimeter security with Zero Trust architecture, tailored hybrid cloud solutions, and highly secure networks.
Cloud and application optimization — secure infrastructure deployment (PaaS, SaaS, and IaaS), application transformation and optimization (DevOps/DevSecOps), process automation, and API security.

Tactical and operational support — security posture and maturity assessment, deployment of controls (EDR-XDR-MDR), identity and access management (IDaaS), cybersecurity audits, and 24/7 managed services.

Cyber resilience — backup and archiving, email security, regular updates to your IT security tools, security of your infrastructure, network, and work environments, plus expertise in crisis management and cyber insurance.
